en.title: Play the South Gate act of Lantern Shadows on Android
en.body: A local project adapter brings the original first act, Spine characters, scrolling playbill and score records to the trimmed-V8 player. Its native GLES3 draws now support the shadow blend, linear filtering and vertex colors used in this game.

zh.title: 在 Android 原生播放器游玩《灯影·闹天宫》南天门一幕
zh.body: 本地工程适配器接入原版第一幕、Spine 角色、可滚动戏单和成绩记录。裁剪 V8 播放器的 GLES3 绘制现已支持本作使用的阴影混合、线性采样和逐顶点着色。
